description: This file is a test class for the ScssHelper service within the OrangeHRM project's CorporateBranding plugin. It contains unit tests for methods that manipulate color values such as darken, lighten, rgba, and color validation.

classes.name: ScssHelperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ScssHelper service methods related to color manipulation and validation.

methods.name: testDarken
methods.description: Tests the darken method of the ScssHelper class with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testLighten
methods.description: Tests the lighten method of the ScssHelper class with various color inputs and percentage values.

methods.name: testRgba
methods.description: Tests the rgba method of the ScssHelper class with color hex values and opacity levels.

methods.name: testIsColor
methods.description: Tests the isValidColor method of the ScssHelper class with different color string formats.
